        }

        }

            return g.anchor1 = A,

        }

            return C.anchor1 = A,
            C.anchor2 = I,

        }
        static revolute(A, I, g) {
            let C = new A7;
            return C.anchor1 = A,
            C.anchor2 = I,
            C.axis = g,
            C.jointType = gD.Revolute,
            C
        }
        intoRaw() {
            let A, I, g = AP.intoRaw(this.anchor1), C = AP.intoRaw(this.anchor2), B = !1, Q = 0, E = 0;
            switch (this.jointType) {
            case gD.Fixed:
                let i = AV.intoRaw(this.frame1)
                  , D = AV.intoRaw(this.frame2);
                I = $.fixed(g, i, C, D),
                i.free(),
                D.free();
                break;
            case gD.Spring:
                I = $.spring(this.length, this.stiffness, this.damping, g, C);
                break;
            case gD.Rope:
                I = $.rope(this.length, g, C);
                break;
            case gD.Prismatic:
                A = AP.intoRaw(this.axis),
                this.limitsEnabled && (B = !0,
                Q = this.limits[0],
                E = this.limits[1]),
                I = $.prismatic(g, C, A, B, Q, E),
                A.free();
                break;
            case gD.Generic:
                A = AP.intoRaw(this.axis);
                let o = this.axesMask;
                I = $.generic(g, C, A, o);
                break;
            case gD.Spherical:
                I = $.spherical(g, C);
                break;
            case gD.Revolute:
                A = AP.intoRaw(this.axis),
                I = $.revolute(g, C, A),
                A.free()
            }
            return g.free(),
            C.free(),
            I
        }

    class IF {
        constructor(A, I, g, C, B) {
            this.distance = A,
            this.point1 = I,
            this.point2 = g,
            this.normal1 = C,
            this.normal2 = B
        }
        static fromRaw(A) {
            if (!A)
                return null;
            let I = new IF(A.distance(),AP.fromRaw(A.point1()),AP.fromRaw(A.point2()),AP.fromRaw(A.normal1()),AP.fromRaw(A.normal2()));
            return A.free(),
            I
        }
    }
    class Ia {
        static fromRaw(A, I) {
            let g, C, B, Q, E, i, D = A.coShapeType(I);
            switch (D) {
            case c.Ball:
                return new Is(A.coRadius(I));
            case c.Cuboid:
                return new IY((g = A.coHalfExtents(I)).x,g.y,g.z);
            case c.RoundCuboid:
                return g = A.coHalfExtents(I),
                C = A.coRoundRadius(I),
                new Iq(g.x,g.y,g.z,C);
            case c.Capsule:
                return new Ic(E = A.coHalfHeight(I),i = A.coRadius(I));
            case c.Segment:
                return B = A.coVertices(I),
                new IL(AP.new(B[0], B[1], B[2]),AP.new(B[3], B[4], B[5]));
            case c.Polyline:
                return new It(B = A.coVertices(I),Q = A.coIndices(I));
            case c.Triangle:
                return B = A.coVertices(I),
                new Il(AP.new(B[0], B[1], B[2]),AP.new(B[3], B[4], B[5]),AP.new(B[6], B[7], B[8]));
            case c.RoundTriangle:
                return B = A.coVertices(I),
                C = A.coRoundRadius(I),
                new IH(AP.new(B[0], B[1], B[2]),AP.new(B[3], B[4], B[5]),AP.new(B[6], B[7], B[8]),C);
            case c.HalfSpace:
                return new IR(AP.fromRaw(A.coHalfspaceNormal(I)));
            case c.Voxels:
                return new Ip(A.coVoxelData(I),A.coVoxelSize(I));
            case c.TriMesh:
                return new Ie(B = A.coVertices(I),Q = A.coIndices(I),A.coTriMeshFlags(I));
            case c.HeightField:
                let o = A.coHeightfieldScale(I)
                  , w = A.coHeightfieldHeights(I);
                return new IO(A.coHeightfieldNRows(I),A.coHeightfieldNCols(I),w,o,A.coHeightFieldFlags(I));
            case c.ConvexPolyhedron:
                return new Ir(B = A.coVertices(I),Q = A.coIndices(I));
            case c.RoundConvexPolyhedron:
                return B = A.coVertices(I),
                new IT(B,Q = A.coIndices(I),C = A.coRoundRadius(I));
            case c.Cylinder:
                return new Id(E = A.coHalfHeight(I),i = A.coRadius(I));
            case c.RoundCylinder:
                return E = A.coHalfHeight(I),
                new In(E,i = A.coRadius(I),C = A.coRoundRadius(I));
            case c.Cone:
                return new IZ(E = A.coHalfHeight(I),i = A.coRadius(I));
            case c.RoundCone:
                return E = A.coHalfHeight(I),
                new Ij(E,i = A.coRadius(I),C = A.coRoundRadius(I));
            default:
                throw Error("unknown shape type: " + D)
            }
        }
        castShape(A, I, g, C, B, Q, E, i, D, o) {
            let w = AP.intoRaw(A)
              , S = AV.intoRaw(I)
              , G = AP.intoRaw(g)
              , k = AP.intoRaw(B)
              , K = AV.intoRaw(Q)
              , U = AP.intoRaw(E)
              , h = this.intoRaw()
              , y = C.intoRaw()
              , N = Ih.fromRaw(null, h.castShape(w, S, G, y, k, K, U, i, D, o));
            return w.free(),
            S.free(),
            G.free(),
            k.free(),
            K.free(),
            U.free(),
            h.free(),
            y.free(),
            N
        }
        intersectsShape(A, I, g, C, B) {
            let Q = AP.intoRaw(A)
              , E = AV.intoRaw(I)
              , i = AP.intoRaw(C)
              , D = AV.intoRaw(B)
              , o = this.intoRaw()
              , w = g.intoRaw()
              , S = o.intersectsShape(Q, E, w, i, D);
            return Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D.free(),
            o.free(),
            w.free(),
            S
        }
        contactShape(A, I, g, C, B, Q) {
            let E = AP.intoRaw(A)
              , i = AV.intoRaw(I)
              , D = AP.intoRaw(C)
              , o = AV.intoRaw(B)
              , w = this.intoRaw()
              , S = g.intoRaw()
              , G = IF.fromRaw(w.contactShape(E, i, S, D, o, Q));
            return E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D.free(),
            o.free(),
            w.free(),
            S.free(),
            G
        }
        containsPoint(A, I, g) {
            let C = AP.intoRaw(A)
              , B = AV.intoRaw(I)
              , Q = AP.intoRaw(g)
              , E = this.intoRaw()
              , i = E.containsPoint(C, B, Q);
            return C.free(),
            B.free(),
            Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i
        }
        projectPoint(A, I, g, C) {
            let B = AP.intoRaw(A)
              , Q = AV.intoRaw(I)
              , E = AP.intoRaw(g)
              , i = this.intoRaw()
              , D = IK.fromRaw(i.projectPoint(B, Q, E, C));
            return B.free(),
            Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D
        }
        intersectsRay(A, I, g, C) {
            let B = AP.intoRaw(I)
              , Q = AV.intoRaw(g)
              , E = AP.intoRaw(A.origin)
              , i = AP.intoRaw(A.dir)
              , D = this.intoRaw()
              , o = D.intersectsRay(B, Q, E, i, C);
            return B.free(),
            Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D.free(),
            o
        }
        castRay(A, I, g, C, B) {
            let Q = AP.intoRaw(I)
              , E = AV.intoRaw(g)
              , i = AP.intoRaw(A.origin)
              , D = AP.intoRaw(A.dir)
              , o = this.intoRaw()
              , w = o.castRay(Q, E, i, D, C, B);
            return Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D.free(),
            o.free(),
            w
        }
        castRayAndGetNormal(A, I, g, C, B) {
            let Q = AP.intoRaw(I)
              , E = AV.intoRaw(g)
              , i = AP.intoRaw(A.origin)
              , D = AP.intoRaw(A.dir)
              , o = this.intoRaw()
              , w = IS.fromRaw(o.castRayAndGetNormal(Q, E, i, D, C, B));
            return Q.free(),
            E.free(),
            i.free(),
            D.free(),
            o.free(),
            w
        }
    }
